A device os-netreport saw reaching a command-and-control list is isolated by its MAC address for the time set under Settings: nothing it sends passes the firewall and nothing reaches it through it. Never the firewall itself, its gateways, or an address this page was opened from.

A listed device is stopped at the firewall: nothing it sends passes through it, and nothing reaches it through it. Two devices behind the same switch still reach each other - their frames never come to the firewall.
